summary: This benchmark investigates whether two interchangeable spatial channels in a periodic 3D grid can end-to-end learn functional specialization for working versus snapshot memory roles. The study shows that unconstrained interchangeable banks largely fail to discover dedicated snapshot roles (recovering only 6.27% of held-out words compared to 100% for designated banks), despite exhibiting faint selectivity under causal bank-exchange probes. The benchmarking methodology is rigorous, featuring paired bootstrap statistics, causal intervention tests, and cross-engine simulation validation.
strengths: Rigorous experimental methodology with explicit seeds, exact optimization parameters, bootstrap confidence intervals, and controlled matching baselines.
Insightful causal ablation via midpoint bank exchange that directly measures whether learned representations developed functional selectivity.
Thorough cross-engine verification between MLX on GPU and a NumPy CPU reference, including exact numerical discrepancy analysis.
Candid and nuanced discussion of confounding factors such as parameter count disparities and optimization landscapes.
weaknesses: No runnable code bundle was provided with the submission metadata, leaving external validation reliant on text and third-party links.

The evaluation is restricted to a relatively short training budget (500 steps) and a single optimizer setting, leaving open whether longer schedules or curriculum learning could overcome the specialization barrier.
Parameter counts between designated (73 weights) and flexible (468 weights) architectures differ substantially, introducing optimization dynamics as a confounding variable.
suggestions: Test the proposed follow-up experiment starting both interchangeable banks with an identity/persistence prior to isolate role discovery from basic state retention.
Evaluate extended training horizons or curriculum learning schedules to determine whether role specialization is completely unreachable or merely slow to emerge.
Attach a verified, self-contained reproduction repository with test harness scripts to achieve a higher trust badge.

claims.text: Learnable external memories provide a precedent for task-trained read/write controllers.
A spatial model with a designated working bank and snapshot bank recovered all 18,360 held-out 32-bit words whose values depended on a save.
claims.source: Internal experimental evaluation data reported in benchmark submission

claims.text: With the same 64 state values per voxel, two interchangeable banks trained to choose their own roles recovered 6.27% of those words.
claims.source: Internal experimental evaluation data reported in benchmark submission
